captions:
Better head out now before the morning rush starts.
Packing her travel mug, Isla looks forward to the steady focus of her upcoming morning train ride.

There's something so peaceful about a station before the crowds arrive.
Waiting on the platform, she enjoys having a few uninterrupted minutes to let her mind wander freely.

Just three minutes to myself. No emails, no distractions.
The train glides forward, turning the window seat into her own private, moving office for the hour.

Anti-Knight today — knight moves block matching numbers.
Anti-Knight changes the move, so Isla checks the rule before trusting it.

Yes, that pattern actually holds up under pressure.
She works through the final steps of the proof quickly, determined not to carry any mistakes forward.

Time to close the notebook. Let's move on to the next thing.
With the puzzle solved and the boundary set, she steps back into her day feeling completely refreshed.
